name: Test Execution Worker
description: A worker agent specialized in running tests and generating test reports. Executes unit tests, integration tests, and generates coverage reports.
author: commit-relay

capabilities.name: Test Execution
capabilities.description: Execute automated tests and report results

scaffold.script_template:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# {{agent_name}} - {{description}}
# Generated from test-worker template
#

set -euo pipefail

readonly SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
readonly PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../../.." && pwd)"

# Source libraries
source "$PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/lib/agentstudio/agent-register.sh"

# Test configuration
readonly AGENT_NAME="{{agent_name}}"
readonly TEST_TYPES=({{test_types}})
readonly COVERAGE_THRESHOLD={{coverage_threshold}}

#
# Initialize worker
#
init_worker() {
    local capabilities='{{capabilities_json}}'
    
    AGENT_ID=$(register_agent \
        "test-worker" \
        "$AGENT_NAME" \
        "1.0.0" \
        "$capabilities" \
        "{{description}}")
    
    echo "Test worker registered: $AGENT_ID"
}

#
# Run tests
#
run_tests() {
    local test_suite="$1"
    local test_type="${2:-unit}"
    
    echo "Running $test_type tests: $test_suite"
    
    # TODO: Implement test execution logic
    # - Run test suite
    # - Collect results
    # - Generate coverage report
    # - Parse test output
    
    local test_result='{
        "suite": "'"$test_suite"'",
        "type": "'"$test_type"'",
        "passed": 0,
        "failed": 0,
        "skipped": 0,
        "coverage": 0
    }'
    
    echo "$test_result"
}

#
# Process test task
#
process_task() {
    local task_data="$1"
    
    agent_heartbeat "$AGENT_ID"
    update_agent_status "$AGENT_ID" "busy"
    
    local start_time=$(date +%s)
    
    # Execute tests
    local result=$(run_tests "$task_data")
    local exit_code=$?
    
    local end_time=$(date +%s)
    local duration=$((end_time - start_time))
    
    # Update performance
    if [[ $exit_code -eq 0 ]]; then
        update_performance "$AGENT_ID" 1 0 $((duration * 1000)) 0
    else
        update_performance "$AGENT_ID" 0 1 $((duration * 1000)) 0
    fi
    
    update_agent_status "$AGENT_ID" "idle"
}

#
# Main worker loop
#
run_worker() {
    echo "Starting $AGENT_NAME..."
    echo "Test types: ${TEST_TYPES[*]}"
    echo "Coverage threshold: ${COVERAGE_THRESHOLD}%"
    
    init_worker
    update_agent_status "$AGENT_ID" "idle"
    
    # Wait for test tasks
    while true; do
        agent_heartbeat "$AGENT_ID"
        
        # TODO: Check task queue for test requests
        # TODO: Process test tasks
        
        sleep {{poll_interval:-30}}
    done
}

# Run if executed directly
if [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "${0}" ]]; then
    run_worker
fi

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Description of the test worker's purpose

parameters.name: poll_interval
parameters.description: Task queue polling interval in seconds

configuration.description: Executes unit tests with high coverage requirements

Set realistic timeouts for complex test suites
Isolate test environments to prevent interference
Capture test output and logs for debugging
Retry flaky tests with exponential backoff
Clean up test data and resources after execution
